concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-wechat-pay]] — 2026-09-15 WeChat Pay overview: separate desktop QR/H5, in-app, Mini Program and POS routes; mobile-web initiation is limited to the WeChat app, some outcomes require webhook confirmation, and the matrix limits recurring/capture/chargeback while permitting refunds in this snapshot.
warnings: The broad Desktop QR and H5 mobile-browser link does not override the explicit mobile-web WeChat-app initiation condition; read the child guide before specifying an H5 flow.
Historical overview matrix and linked channels do not prove merchant eligibility, current availability, or payment/refund completion.
